how.title: Four steps to a clear answer

steps.title: Tell us the problem
steps.body: Fill in the form or call us. Your name, mobile number and the problem. That's all.

steps.title: Free 10-minute call
steps.body: Our team calls you, understands the problem and tells you which papers are needed.

steps.title: A fixed-price offer
steps.body: You get a link by SMS or WhatsApp: scope, time, price and government fees.

steps.title: The expert starts work
steps.body: After payment a verified expert does the work. They are paid only once the work is delivered.

experts.title: Who does your work
experts.intro: Members of the Bangladesh Land Surveyor Association who work locally in Savar and Gazipur.
points: We check every expert ourselves: identity, membership and experience
Nobody can sign themselves up; our team creates every profile
No expert gets a case from an office where they have worked

safety.title: Your money and your data, both protected

items.title: No cash in hand
items.body: Every payment goes through LandDoctor. Never give cash to an expert.

items.title: Government fees separate
items.body: Government fees are shown separately with receipts, never mixed into the service price.

items.title: No room for bribes
items.body: We never promise to speed up government work. Right advice, right papers and field work.

items.title: We don't keep your papers
items.body: Photos of documents are seen on WhatsApp. Nothing is stored on our website.

items.title: Refund policy
items.body: Cancel before work starts for a full refund. After work starts, we refund the part not yet done.

items.title: A way to complain
items.body: If anything goes wrong, call the hotline. Every complaint is recorded with your case number.

nrb.title: Living abroad? Handle land at home from where you are
nrb.body: Talk on WhatsApp, pay online and get the report on your phone. Our expert visits the land for you.

items.a: No. LandDoctor is a private service. Verified private experts give advice and do field work. Government applications follow government rules.

items.q: Do you speed up mutation or other government work?
items.a: No. We never take money to speed things up. We tell you the right papers, the right application and the right way, so you don't have to keep going back.
Field work (surveys, land health reports) is in Savar and Gazipur for now. Phone advice is available from anywhere in Bangladesh or abroad. For other areas, join the waiting list.

items.q: Is the free call really free?
items.a: Yes. The first 10-minute call is free. You only get an offer and a price if you want the work done.
From the link in your offer, by bKash, Nagad, Rocket or card. Never give cash to an expert.

items.q: How do I send my papers?
items.a: On the free call our team tells you which papers are needed. Send photos on WhatsApp. The website never collects documents.

items.q: What if I'm not happy with the work?
items.a: Tell us within 7 days of delivery. We'll review it with the expert and fix it, or refund under our refund policy.

cta.title: Don't leave your land problem for later
cta.body: Tell us today. We'll call you to understand it, and the first 10 minutes are free.
